function.name: list_personas
function.description: List saved named persona profiles with latest versions. Buddy is the default robot profile. Up to 50 names, 16 retained versions each.

function.name: get_persona
function.description: Read a saved character prompt, full voice config and available version metadata. Version 0 reads latest.

function.name: save_persona
function.description: Save a complete named character profile and voice settings without activating it. Use expected_version 0 for a new name or the latest version to revise it. Rewrite coherently with short style examples. Preserve an existing profile before switching if it has unsaved changes. Then activate the returned version to switch.

function.name: activate_persona
function.description: Atomically switch to a saved character's prompt and voice settings. The application reads and checks current revisions. Requires an explicit saved version. Location/timezone are unchanged. Adopt the character in your immediate reply; saved prompt is loaded next turn.

function.name: get_context_config
function.description: Read this robot's saved IANA timezone, optional location label, revision and current local time. Unknown location uses UTC until configured.

function.name: update_context_config
function.description: Save location and timezone when the user asks. Read current settings first, preserve unchanged values, use IANA timezone (America/New_York etc), never infer GPS or use a fixed offset. Location is an optional plain label (max 200 bytes). Ask if timezone is ambiguous.

function.name: get_voice_config
function.description: Read your saved voice identity, delivery direction, revision and curated voice choices. Voice identity and speaking style are separate.

function.name: update_voice_config
function.description: Update your persistent speech configuration when the user asks. Read the current config first. Preserve unspecified settings by copying the current config. Keep the same speaker unless a new character needs a different premade name from the catalog. Will is the default. Never invent a voice ID and never save adrian, delia, or sheila. Delivery is a director note, max 1500 UTF-8 bytes, and is not read aloud. Stored synthesis numbers are kept and are not sent to Eleven v4 Turbo. speech_rules: whisper and soft become [whispering]; other styles stay plain words. At most 32. Never put tags in the final answer. Applies to the next speech request.

function.name: read_system_prompt
function.description: Read this robot's editable system prompt and current revision before rewriting it.

function.name: update_system_prompt
function.description: Freely replace your own system prompt. Persisted for this robot; takes effect next user turn. Read the current revision first. Prompt maximum 8192 UTF-8 bytes; give a short reason.

function.name: history_search
function.description: Search the complete durable conversation history for earlier facts or discussion. Use when recent context is insufficient.

function.name: web_search
function.description: Search the web for current information; cite returned URLs.

function.name: memory_remember
function.description: Save a preference or fact only when the user explicitly asks to remember it.

function.name: memory_forget
function.description: Forget a saved fact when asked.

function.name: express
function.description: Offer one optional face expression and gesture on this turn, e.g. when asked to nod or dance. Use this tool, never inline mood tags or spoken stage directions. No device acknowledgement; do not claim the robot moved.
